body:
We retain the evidence for [website #764](https://github.com/code198x/website/pull/764), which brings the reviewed fixed-point state experiment into the existing unit. Six fresh calls to the accepted model functions agree with the earlier traces; the deliberately wrong retention policy exits nonzero. The lesson separates full stored state, decoded position and the whole drawing coordinate, with a hint, explanation and quarter-step variation.

The final production build, 237 tests in 32 files and ten wide/narrow browser behaviour groups pass. Exact rendered rows match the model, six disclosures open by keyboard and four support-link/Back journeys work. Visual review caught split table headings in the initial render; the existing TraceTable component corrects them. No shared component or layout was changed.

Raw axe records show no violations and one narrow listing-line contrast incomplete. A bounded two-endpoint probe measures 16.8168:1 for that text/background pair. This qualifies that uncertainty without claiming blanket accessibility. Source/build/model identities, readable captures, negative controls and all 23 manifest entries are retained. Ruff, Vale and whitespace checks pass.

We link the accepted learner/assessor sheets rather than copying them. No new target execution, timing, motion quality or learner effectiveness is claimed. #114/#115/#124 stay open. After review, prioritise approved publication and reproduced blockers for tomorrow's readiness pass.
title: Qualify the repeated fixed-point lesson experiment
